notes: Synthetic 'hey jarvis' positives (TTS across many voices). Negatives pooled across the not-wake-word collection — general speech, public-domain sounds, environmental audio (ESC-50), music (FMA) and ambient noise — so false-accept rate reflects many scenarios. openWakeWord and microWakeWord both ship a 'hey jarvis' model, so this is a head-to-head neural comparison.
